name: Steady
text: A steady model ignores the first shove each turn.

name: Volley
text: Roll X extra dice when shooting at a model in the open.

name: Weighty
text: Moving with this item costs 1" more. Not with [[kw:steady]] models.

name: Stalwart
text: Never flees from a lost fight.

name: Smoke
text: Leaves a cloud that blocks sight until the next turn.
